reason: The text explicitly portrays the Israelites (Hebrews) as having a specific, promised land. The passage contains multiple key references: (1) God states 'I have established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan (Eretz Canaan), the land of their sojournings' (Exodus 6:4); (2) God promises 'I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you as an inheritance (morasha)' (Exodus 6:8). The text thus explicitly names Canaan as the specific territory designated for the Hebrews as their inherited possession, establishing them as a nation with a defined, covenanted homeland.
